svg.title: The Cross of Victoria: construction sheet
svg.desc: Construction grid for the eight-pointed version at 1:2, with every measure as a ratio of the hoist A: blue arm C 0.173 A, fimbriation D 0.30 C each side, band E, star inset F 0.18 A, star width G, circumradius H, eight-pointed stars with inner radius 1/2 H, and the colours #CA003C, #003C71 and #FFFFFF.
svg.text: Every measure is a ratio of the hoist, A.
Row one: ratio to the hoist. Row two: on a 600 hoist.
Brodie O’Dunn, after John Vaughan’s Greater Melbourne Ensign
